sentences.text: No, the May 7, 2014 circular on foreclosure charges/pre-payment penalty on floating rate term loans is no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
It was withdrawn/repealed by the Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025 with effect from 2026-01-01.
The 2014 circular is identified as “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on Floating Rate Term Loans” in the repeal table.
